agreement_user_description: The terms of the esports talent assessment service: service scope, accounts, minor protection, test data, payments and refunds, and conduct rules.
agreement_privacy_description: What we collect, how we use and share it, and the rights you hold over your personal information.
agreement_demo_note: Demo copy — the final text awaits legal sign-off
agreement_user_c1_d: This product provides esports talent assessment and reporting. Results are derived from your play data and serve self-understanding and training reference only — they do not constitute medical or psychological diagnosis, or any hiring commitment.
agreement_user_c2_d: You must register with a real mobile number; one number maps to one account. WeChat and phone sign-in can be bound to the same account (see account linking).
agreement_user_c3_d: Users under 13 must use the service accompanied by a guardian and with guardian consent; users under 18 may not purchase paid reports or membership.
agreement_user_c4_d: In-test process data (per-frame / per-event) powers reports and product improvement; real-name information never enters the assessment store.
agreement_user_c5_d: A single report unlocks that report permanently for ¥19.9; membership is ¥29.9/month — tests unlock automatically while subscribed, and reports unlocked during the period stay yours. Digital content counts as delivered on release and is non-refundable by default (exceptions are handled offline); see the payment page for details.
agreement_user_c6_d: Cheating tools, scripted score farming, and bulk registration are prohibited; violating accounts may be restricted or banned.
agreement_privacy_c1_d: Account information (mobile number, WeChat openid, nickname, avatar), profile information (sex, birth year-month / age band, game preferences), device and sign-in information (device model, IP, sign-in region), and assessment data (scores, per-event records).
agreement_privacy_c2_d: We resolve your sign-in IP to a province-level region for statistics and report comparison; historical records update alongside.
agreement_privacy_c3_d: Generating ability reports; matching assessment content; statistics and product improvement; compliance evidence (consent records: timestamp + version).
agreement_privacy_c4_d: We never sell your personal information. Share cards carry only the ability information you choose to make public; minors' share cards carry no real-name information.
agreement_privacy_c5_d: You can unbind WeChat / your phone number, or change or reset your password, at any time under “Account & security”; you can request account-data deletion through “Feedback”.
agreement_privacy_c6_d: Completed assessment records are kept permanently; unfinished progress is kept for 7 days. After account deletion, only the compliance records required by law are retained for the shortest period required.
agreement_consent_note: When you sign in with the consent boxes checked, the system records the agreement versions and the time you consented, for compliance evidence.
